$comment: Tool and kit ideas aimed at East Texas business pains. An item is scaffolded only after Ryan approves it (status approved, approvedBy, approvedOn). Prices for pro kits come from PRO_PRICES; the number here is a proposal.

items.name: Seasonal Cash Gap Planner
items.pain: Lawn, pool, HVAC, and roofing crews in East Texas earn eight months of the year and pay twelve. The slow-season shortfall is a surprise every January.
items.sources: Owner-entered monthly revenue and fixed costs; no external data.

items.name: Storm Season Lead Surge Planner
items.pain: After a hail or wind event a roofer or tree service gets three weeks of calls at once and loses half of them to whoever answers first.
items.audience: Roofers, tree services, fence and gutter crews
items.sources: Owner-entered call volume and answer capacity; no weather data claimed.

items.name: Crew Day Rate Calculator
items.pain: A two-person crew with a truck and a trailer costs more per day than the owner quotes, because fuel, insurance, and idle days are never in the number.
items.audience: Trades with a crew and a truck
items.sources: Owner-entered wages, vehicle, insurance, and working days.

items.name: Google Business Profile Checklist Generator
items.pain: Most Longview service businesses have a half-finished Google profile: no hours, no services, three photos from 2019, and a category that is wrong.
items.sources: A fixed checklist; no scraping of the live profile.

items.name: Church and Nonprofit Event Budget Planner
items.pain: A fall festival or a fundraiser dinner gets planned on a napkin, and the volunteer treasurer finds out the shortfall after the event.
items.sources: Organizer-entered costs, ticket price, and expected attendance.

items.name: New Patient Intake Kit
items.pain: A dental or medical front desk re-types the same intake three times and loses the new patient between the call and the chair.
items.sources: Office-entered fields; generates forms and scripts from them.

items.name: After-Hours Call Plan Kit
items.pain: Plumbers and electricians in East Texas get emergency calls at 9 PM and the phone goes to a voicemail nobody checks until morning.
items.sources: Owner-entered hours, on-call rotation, and pricing; generates the greeting, the text-back, and the rota.

items.name: Estimate to Invoice Checklist Kit
items.pain: Jobs finish and invoices go out a week later, or not at all, because nobody owns the handoff from the estimate to the bill.
items.sources: Owner-entered job stages; generates the checklist and the reminder texts.
